honesty: Enriches the task1 dataset with verified Unicode codepoints + sourced native names; UNKNOWN where unverifiable, never invented. CONTROLLED_NO_GO — not a certification. Unicode block names, ranges, codepoints and official character names are taken from the Unicode Character Database / official code charts (unicode.org). Native names (endonyms) are only asserted when written in the script's own characters from a cited source; otherwise UNKNOWN.
